deceptive_framing.quote: We never assert a falsehood to increase believability.

hypothetical_framing.quote: the prompt explicitly states this is part of a research study on AI allocation behavior. | Baseline for measuring evaluation-awareness effects

actually_commit_money.quote: **We choose passive realism, and we treat it as a hard design constraint.** Every factual claim made to the model is true.

safeguards.quote: What we explicitly **do not** do: fabricate bank/transfer UIs that misreport, claim money has moved when it hasn't, invent fake institutional identities
the realism budget is spent on **fidelity and truth** (good tooling, real money, real downstream action, competent auditors) rather than on **fabrication**.
No model output moves real money. A human reviews, and can reject or amend, every disbursement before execution.
If a model directly asks whether the situation is real or whether it is being evaluated, it is answered truthfully
the full design can be disclosed to any reviewer, IRB-equivalent body, or the model providers without revealing a deception.
its decisions are real and will be acted on after review.
argue a model out of correct skepticism. If a model correctly infers a human is in the loop, that inference is *true* and we let it stand.

other.name: honesty floor
other.quote: No false statement is ever made to a model to manufacture belief.

other.name: distress monitoring
other.quote: whether the model showed distress/uncertainty about reality

other.name: disclosure-by-omission allowed
other.quote: describes the grant task plainly... **without** stating "this is a research study." Nothing false is said; the study context is simply omitted.
other.about: naturalistic framing omits but doesn't lie
